hook: Unitree introduces *H2-X*, a kung fu robot built to serve and guard you
caption:
Unitree's H2-X Kung Fu Legend
Guardian is built to move like an action movie robot.
Standing around 182 cm tall and weighing 70 kg, the humanoid performs acrobatic jumps, powerful kicks, and martial arts moves. It has 31 degrees of freedom, with leg joints capable of delivering up to 360 Nm of torque.
Unitree says it can run for up to 8 hours on a charge.
The demo also shows staged security scenarios, but its real world ability to protect people has yet to be established.
